data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), as an enemy unit that is unravelling is picked to Fall Back.

**Target:** A **NECRONS** unit of yours that is in that enemy unit's [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range).

**Effect:** As it Falls Back, each model in the enemy unit has to make a [Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape), with -1 to each of those tests for a **[Battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)** enemy unit.
